description: tests/integration.rs:257 — vec![i as u8; 32] where i: usize. While N=30 is safe, the cast is flagged by Clippy pedantic cast_possible_truncation. Use u8::try_from(i).expect("i < 256") or simply assert the invariant. This makes the safety constraint explicit and prevents a silent bug if N is ever increased beyond 255.
title: [rusty/pkix-path-builder] cast_possible_truncation on i as u8 in adversarial test
